promptSuffix: Colour grade: saturated carnival neon — magenta, electric blue, acid yellow, warm amber of bulb strings. The beauty should feel slightly too much, slightly sad, the way carnival light always does.

translations.real vs. performance: the person behind the face paint
translations.beautiful vs. ugly: the thing that is both at once under carnival light
translations.winning vs. losing: the prize and the walk home without it
translations.bright vs. dark: the gap between the lit ride and the field beyond
translations.season vs. end of season: the carnival on its last night
translations.spectacle vs. ordinary: the waltzer and the man who runs it
translations.last night vs. first night: the carnival opening and the carnival closing
translations.gaudy vs. sublime: the moment the neon becomes something else
translations.passing vs. permanent: what passes through and what was here before and will remain
translations.innocent vs. knowing: the child who believed and the adult who remembers
